title: Zingy Jaggery Idli Sake
description: A spicy, gooey Punjabi dish featuring a unique blend of idlis and sake, suitable for those with egg allergies.

ingredients.name: 2 eggs, beaten (optional, for idli)
ingredients.notes: For egg-free version, use mashed potatoes instead.

instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add mustard seeds and curry leaves. Stir for about 10 seconds.
Add jaggery and water to the pan. Stir until fully dissolved.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Simmer for about 15 minutes or until mixture thickens into a gravy-like consistency.
If using eggs, mix them with mashed potatoes. Add to the jaggery mixture and stir well.
Stir in salt and grated ginger if using. Adjust seasoning as needed.
Pour into a greased idli mold and steam for about 10-12 minutes or until cooked through.
Serve hot with a side of raita or mint chutney.
